title: Audio Data Recording - Thai
description: We are looking for Thai native speakers with a Central Thai accent to participate in a short-term audio recording project. Participants will record simple voice commands in Thai to help improve speech recognition technology. The project requires approximately 100–150 participants, with an equal distribution of genders. Selected participants will complete recordings from a quiet indoor environment using their own device. It is ideal for individuals interested in contributing to the development of speech and AI voice technologies while completing a short, flexible remote task. Project Details Job Type: Freelance Start Date: Immediately Duration: Up to 3 weeks Total recordings required: 800 recordings. Schedule: Flexible, work at your own availability. Rate: 8 USD / hour Responsibilities Record short Thai voice commands, approximately 10 words each. Follow the recording setup and environment guidelines provided during training. Submit recordings within the project timeline. Requirements Native Thai speaker with a Central Thai accent (mandatory). Access to a smartphone, laptop, or recording device. Ability to record in a quiet indoor environment. Ability to follow audio recording instructions carefully. Qualification Process Submit application and complete an initial screening questionnaire Complete language assessments to evaluate proficiency in both Thai and English Successfully pass internal evaluation to move forward in the process Participants must submit a few sample recordings for qualification. Training includes reviewing project guidelines and recording practice samples. Training is paid once the participant successfully qualifies for production (flat 30-minute training fee). #LI-CAN17
